definitions.short: to be foul , especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
definitions.usage: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, × utterly.
definitions.full: H2930. tame I. טָמֵא verb be or become unclean (Late Hebrew Pi`el pollute (ceremonially); Aramaic טְמָא and especially derivatives, Pa`el pollute ; see RS K 307 ff. ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ט Lev 11:25 22 t.; 3 feminine singular טָֽמְאָה 12:2 2 t.; 2 feminine singular טָמֵאת Ezek 22:4 ; plural טָֽמְאוּ Lev 15:18 ; Imperfect יִטְמָא 5:3 34t.; 3 feminine singular תִּטְמָא 12:2 4 t.; plural יִטְמְאוּ Psa 106:39 ; Infinitive טָמְאָה Lev 15:32 6 t.; — be or become unclean: 1 sexually , with בְּ Lev 18:20 , 23 (H), Ezek 23:17 ; the land Lev 18:25 , 27 (H). 2 religiously, with idols Ezek 22:3 ; with בְ 22:4 ; with necromancers Lev 19:31 (H); by sacrificing children to idols Psa 106:39 . 3 ceremonially, by contact with carcasses of unclean animals Lev 11:24 , 27 , 28 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 (twice in verse); 11:35-36 , 40 (P); any carcass 17:15 (H); eating of a carcass 22:8 (H); by issues 15:4 , 9 , 20 (twice in verse); 15:24 , 27 , 32 (P); by contact with an unclean man 5:3 ; 15:4 (P), 22:5 (H), or thing 22:6 (H); by leprosy 13:14 , 46 ; 14:36 , 46 (P); by contact with the dead Num 6:12 ; 19:20 (P), Ezek 44:25 , or with one unclean by such contact Num 19:22 (P), Hag 2:13 (twice in verse); by contact with creeping things Lev 22:5 (H); certain animals were always unclean 11:26-27 , (P). In ordinary cases of uncleanness הערב עד טמא unclean till even 11:24-25 , 27 , 28 , 31 , 32 , 39 , 40 (twice in verse); 14:46 ; 15:5 ; 15:6 ; 15:7 ; 15:8 ; 15:10 (twice in verse); 15:11 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 27 ; Num 19:7 ; 19:8 ; 19:10 ; 19:21 ; 19:22 (all P), Lev 17:15 ; 22:6 (H); but uncleanness lasted 7 days for woman bearings a son 12:2 (twice in verse) (P), for lying with woman having an issue 15:24 (P), or one coming in contact with the dead Num 19:11 , 14 , 16 (P); it lasted 14 days for a woman bearing a daughter Lev 12:5 (P). Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִטְמָא Hosea 5:3 ; 6:10 ; 3 feminine singular נִטְמְאָה Num 5:27-28 , נִטְמָ֑אָה 5:13 5 t.; 1 singular נִטְמֵאתִי Jer 2:23 ; 2 masculine plural נִטְמֵתֶם Lev 11:43 ( א omitted by scribal error; but Ges and others derive from טמה ), etc. + 4 t. perfect; Participle plural נִטְמְאִים Ezek 20:30-31 , — defile oneself, be defiled: 1 sexually , Lev 18:24 (H), Num 5:13-14 , (twice in verse); 5:20 , 27 , 28 , 29 (P). 2 by idolatry conceived as whoredom Hosea 5:3 ; 6:10 ; Jer 2:23 ; Ezek 20:30-31 , 43 ; 23:7 , 13 , 30 . 3 ceremonially, by eating creeping things Lev 11:43 . 4 be regarded as unclean (compare Pi`el 4 ), probably נִטְמִינִוּ Job 18:3 we are accounted as unclean ; metal. from; on another view see טמה . Pi`el Perfect טִמֵּא Gen 34:5 15 t.; suffix טִמְּאוֺ Lev 13:8 3 t.; 2 feminine singular טִמֵּאת Ezek 5:11 , etc. + 7 t. Perfect; Imperfect יְטַמֵּא 2Kin 23:8 , etc. + 12 t. Imperfect; Imperative plural טַמְּאוּ Ezek 9:7 ; Infinitive טַמֵּא Lev 13:44 2 t.; suffix טַמְּאָם 15:31 , etc. + 4 t. Infinitive; — defile: 1 sexually Gen 34:5 , 13 , 27 (R), Ezek 18:6 , 11 , 15 ; 22:11 ; 33:26 ; the land by sexual impurities of the people Lev 18:28 (H); Israel by spiritual whoredom Ezek 23:17 . 2 religiously: the land by bloodshed Num 35:34 (P); by allowing the dead body of the murderer to hang on the tree over night Deut 21:23 ; by idolatry Jer 2:7 ; Ezek 36:17-18 , Israel defiled the sacred places by the sacrifice of children Lev 20:3 (H), Ezek 23:38 , and God defiled him thereby 20:26 ; he defileth the sacred places by idolatry 2Chr 36:14 ; Jer 7:30 = 32:34 , Ezek 5:11 ; the holy name of ׳י 43:7-8 , Josiah defiled the idolatrous places of worship by destroying them and making them unfit for use 2Kin 23:8 , 10 , 13 , 16 ; of Israel defiling idolatrous images Isa 30:22 , and the nations the temple of God Psa 79:1 . 3 ceremonially: by ceremonial uncleanness, the sacred places Lev 15:31 ; Num 19:13 , 20 (P); the camp 5:3 (P); the temple by dead bodies Ezek 9:7 ; the Nazirite's head of separation by a death occurring in his presence Num 6:9 (P); the people defile themselves ( נפשׁתיכם ) by creeping things Lev 11:44 (P). 4 pronounce or declare ceremonially unclean: the leper Lev 13:3 , 8 , 11 , 15 , 20 , 22 , 25 , 27 , 30 , 44 (twice in verse); 13:59 (P); unclean animals 20:25 (H). Pu`al Participle מְטֻמָּאָה לֹא נַפְשִׁי Ezek 4:14 myself is not polluted. Hithpa`el Imperfect יִטַּמָּא Lev 21:1 4 t.; plural יִטַּמְּאוּ Ezek 14:11 ; 37:23 ; יִטַּמָּ֑אוּ Hosea 9:4 ; Ezek 44:25 , etc. + 6 t. Imperfect — reflexive, defile oneself: by eating of an unaccepted peace-offering Hosea 9:4 ; with בְּ Lev 18:24 , 30 (H), 11:43 (P), Ezek 14:11 ; 20:7 , 18 ; 37:23 ; with לְ for a dead person Lev 21:1 , 3 , 11 (H), Num 6:7 (P); by Lev 11:24 (P); without preposition 21:4 (H), Ezek 44:25 . Hothpa`al Perfect חֻטַּמָּ֑אָה אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי Deut 24:4 after that she has been defiled (sexually); on form see Ges § 54 . 3. טָמְאָה noun feminine uncleanness ( טָֽמְאָה , Bear, seems to rest upon a misinterpretation of the form) Micah 2:10 (so Thes MV SS); of ethical uncleanness, from wrong-doing.

When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.
If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.† or, seed
“ ‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,
He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.
“ ‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.
He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.
Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
